description:
Hello and welcome to the Copperfield Electric YouTube channel! We are a licensed and insured electrical company based in Orange County, offering residential and commercial services with a 24-hour emergency line for your convenience.

Here on our channel, we strive to provide you with valuable information about everyday electrical topics that can help you live better. From tips on energy efficiency to the latest electrical technology, we're here to educate and inform you about all things related to electrical services.

We're excited to share our knowledge with you and help you better understand the world of electricity. So make sure to hit that subscribe button and stay tuned for our latest videos!
